headline: As of 2026-10-05: 1,271,484 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 30 of 50 states, D+34.3 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 1,271,484 early/mail ballots cast so far across 30 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+34.3 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (349,576), New Jersey (178,984), Florida (155,407).
